items.description: engine/firewall.py (collector a86b4c7) reads the release document via 'git show origin/control/landing-orchestrator:...'. refs/remotes/origin/* is a LOCAL file forgeable by any actor with local write access via 'git update-ref' — no push, credentials, or network needed. A forged RELEASED document can therefore be read by the firewall as genuine. Same defect class as _resolve_branch_tip exploited by adversarial this morning and fixed in V2-C015.
items.why_not_fixed_today: fixing moves collector SHA and breaks E000->E001 batch-0 reuse (TIMEBOX §7). Gate was legitimately opened; mitigation = B fetches immediately before launch. Mitigation, not resolution.
items.remediation: ls-remote only + fail-closed; reference implementation already exists in research/landing_accessibility/scripts/promote_landing_main.sh (V2-C015 _resolve_branch_tip).
items.limitations_sentence: 수집 개시 판정이 읽는 릴리스 문서 경로가 로컬 추적 ref 기반이며, 이는 로컬 쓰기 권한을 가진 행위자가 위조할 수 있다. 오늘 수집에서는 발사 직전 fetch 로 완화했다.
